question: Which of the following is the symbol of the unit of atomic mass?
solution:
The correct answer is __**u**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The atomic mass unit (amu) is denoted by the symbol **u**.
 
• It is a standard unit of mass that quantifies mass on an atomic or molecular scale.
 
• One atomic mass unit is defined as one-twelfth the mass of a carbon-12 atom.
 
• This unit is used to express the relative masses of atoms and molecules.
 
• The use of the atomic mass unit simplifies the comparison and calculation of atomic and molecular masses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mole**

 
 
• A mole is a unit in chemistry that denotes an amount of substance containing Avogadro's number (approximately 6.022 x 10²³) of particles, such as atoms, molecules, or ions.
 
• The mole is a fundamental unit in the International System of Units (SI).
 
 
 
• **Avogadro's Number**
 
 
• Avogadro's number is the number of particles in one mole of a substance, which is approximately 6.022 x 10²³.
 
• This constant allows chemists to count particles by weighing macroscopic amounts of material.
 
 
 
• **Molar Mass**
 
 
• The molar mass of a substance is the mass of one mole of that substance, typically expressed in grams per mole (g/mol).
 
• Molar mass is used to convert between the mass of a substance and the amount in moles.
